_about: Per-word progress rules (js/core/progress.js; rule G23; target-model § 3.3). A word has an understand_stage and a produce_stage, 1 to 5. advanceAfter[stage] = correct recalls from the Kutchi needed at that stage to go up one (stage 1 -> 2 needs none: meeting the word is enough, as in Cook). Two misses in a row drop a stage; once met, understanding never drops below floorOnceMet; dropStreak[stage] = the recalls already counted on the stage it drops to. Only evidence with a cue in recallCues counts as recall (the child had only the Kutchi to go on). cookImport.base: the right-answer count at which each of Cook's four stages starts (js/cook/core.js Cook.wordStage), used to import Cook's words. support[stage]: how much help a word gets (the label, the card text or dots, the hint delay, auto-play, a picture); stages 1-4 match Cook's labelMode, cardHidden and data/cook.json calm.hintMs today.
